dialogues.speaker: Yamaue
dialogues.text: The Tenryou Commission has sent a load of people to Ritou. I guess it must have something to do with the wedding.

dialogues.speaker: Yamaue
dialogues.text: I think in all there must have been about a hundred people so far.

dialogues.speaker: Tokunaga
dialogues.text: That doesn't sound good. What could be going on?

dialogues.speaker: Tokunaga
dialogues.text: Ah, I hope it's just Sir Kujou Kamaji being overcautious.
